mapper.select:
/* AppStatusMapper.selectList */
SELECT Z.* , BIZDS.AI_INPT_CMN_CD_NM AS INPT_ATMC_BIZ_NM , Y.XPBY_COL_CTR_CUCD AS FC_CUNM , PRCS.AI_INPT_CMN_CD_NM AS INPT_PRCSNM , ATVT.AI_INPT_CMN_CD_NM AS INPT_ATVTNM , TOTRST.AI_INPT_CMN_CD_ENG_NM AS TOTALTEXT_AI_INPT_RST_NM , ITMRST.AI_INPT_CMN_CD_ENG_NM AS ITM_INPT_AI_INPT_RST_NM , SAFRST.AI_INPT_CMN_CD_ENG_NM AS SAFEWATCH_AI_INPT_RST_NM , Y.XPBY_COL_AM AS AI_INPT_BUY_AM , Y.CUS_KORL_NM AS AI_INPT_CUS_NM , Y.CSNO AS AI_INPT_CSNO , ( SELECT MAX(FILT_DTCT_NO) FROM CSPD007TL WHERE INPT_MST_SRNO = Z.INPT_MST_SRNO AND AI_INPT_PRG_SRNO = (SELECT MAX(AI_INPT_PRG_SRNO) FROM CSPD007TL WHERE INPT_MST_SRNO = Z.INPT_MST_SRNO) ) AS FILT_DTCT_NO FROM ( SELECT '3' AS AI_INPT_BIZ_DSCD , A.ACTL_FX_REFNO
, A.AI_INPT_QLAS_PROS_CD AS PRCS_CD , A.AI_INPT_QLAS_ACVT_CD AS ATVT_CD , A.TOTALTEXT_AI_INPT_RST_CD , A.ITM_INPT_AI_INPT_RST_CD , A.SAFEWATCH_AI_INPT_RST_CD , A.INPT_MST_SRNO , A.INPT_RCP_DT , A.AI_INPT_IMG_KEY_NO , A.FX_REFNO_SRNO , D.AI_INPT_CMN_CD_NM AS WRR_INFO FROM CSPD001TM A , ( SELECT INPT_MST_SRNO , AI_INPT_ACVT_STS_CD , AI_INPT_BIZ_DSCD , K.AI_INPT_CMN_CD_NM AS AI_INPT_CMN_CD_NM , ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY INPT_MST_SRNO ORDER BY AI_INPT_PRG_SRNO DESC) AS RN FROM CSPD008TH C , CSPD112TI K WHERE C.AI_INPT_ACVT_STS_CD IN ('120','100') AND C.AI_INPT_BIZ_DSCD = '3' AND K.AI_INPT_GRP_CD = '300' AND K.AI_INPT_CMN_CD = C.AI_INPT_ACVT_STS_CD ) D WHERE A.QLAS_SNPE_ENO = #{userId} AND A.AI_INPT_QLAS_ACVT_CD IN ('110', '160') AND A.AI_INPT_QLAS_APPV_STCD IN ('120', '160') AND D.INPT_MST_SRNO (+)= A.INPT_MST_SRNO
AND D.RN (+)= 1
AND A.ACTL_FX_REFNO LIKE '%' || UPPER(#{actlFxRefno}) || '%'
UNION ALL
SELECT A.INPT_ATMC_BIZ_DSCD AS AI_INPT_BIZ_DSCD , A.ACTL_FX_REFNO
, A.AI_INPT_PROS_CD AS PRCS_CD , A.AI_INPT_ACVT_CD AS ATVT_CD , A.TOTALTEXT_AI_INPT_RST_CD , A.ITM_INPT_AI_INPT_RST_CD , A.SAFEWATCH_AI_INPT_RST_CD , A.INPT_MST_SRNO , A.INPT_RCP_DT , A.AI_INPT_IMG_KEY_NO , A.FX_REFNO_SRNO , D.AI_INPT_CMN_CD_NM AS WRR_INFO FROM CSPD001TM A , ( SELECT INPT_MST_SRNO , AI_INPT_ACVT_STS_CD , AI_INPT_BIZ_DSCD , CASE WHEN C.AI_INPT_ACVT_CD = '40' THEN '재추출' WHEN C.AI_INPT_ACVT_CD = '70' THEN '재심사' ELSE K.AI_INPT_CMN_CD_NM END AS AI_INPT_CMN_CD_NM , ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY INPT_MST_SRNO ORDER BY AI_INPT_PRG_SRNO DESC) AS RN FROM CSPD008TH C , CSPD112TI K WHERE (C.AI_INPT_ACVT_STS_CD IN ('60', '70', '100', '120') OR C.AI_INPT_ACVT_CD IN ('40', '70')) AND (C.AI_INPT_BIZ_DSCD IN ('1', '2') OR C.AI_INPT_BIZ_DSCD IS NULL) AND K.AI_INPT_GRP_CD = '300' AND K.AI_INPT_CMN_CD = C.AI_INPT_ACVT_STS_CD ) D WHERE A.AI_INPT_SNPE_ENO = #{userId} AND A.AI_INPT_ACVT_CD IN ('90', '140', '160') AND A.AI_INPT_APPV_STCD IN ('120', '140', '160') AND D.INPT_MST_SRNO (+)= A.INPT_MST_SRNO
AND D.RN (+)= 1
AND A.ACTL_FX_REFNO LIKE '%' || UPPER(#{actlFxRefno}) || '%'
) Z LEFT OUTER JOIN ( SELECT FX_ACNO AS ACTL_FX_REFNO , TDOC_RCP_CUCD AS XPBY_COL_CTR_CUCD , TDOC_RCP_AM AS XPBY_COL_AM , CUS_KORL_NM , CSNO , TDOC_RCP_SRNO AS FX_REFNO_SRNO FROM CSPD202TM
UNION ALL
SELECT FX_ACNO AS ACTL_FX_REFNO , XPBY_COL_CTR_CUCD AS XPBY_COL_CTR_CUCD , XPBY_COL_AM AS XPBY_COL_AM , CUS_KORL_NM , CSNO , XPO_CVRG_MK_SQ AS FX_REFNO_SRNO FROM CSPD201TM ) Y ON Y.ACTL_FX_REFNO = Z.ACTL_FX_REFNO AND Z.FX_REFNO_SRNO = Y.FX_REFNO_SRNO LEFT OUTER JOIN CSPD112TI BIZDS ON BIZDS.AI_INPT_GRP_CD = '150' AND BIZDS.AI_INPT_CMN_CD = Z.AI_INPT_BIZ_DSCD LEFT OUTER JOIN CSPD112TI PRCS ON PRCS.AI_INPT_GRP_CD = '280' AND PRCS.AI_INPT_CMN_CD = Z.PRCS_CD LEFT OUTER JOIN CSPD112TI ATVT ON ATVT.AI_INPT_GRP_CD = '290' AND ATVT.AI_INPT_CMN_CD = Z.ATVT_CD LEFT OUTER JOIN CSPD112TI TOTRST ON TOTRST.AI_INPT_GRP_CD = '170' AND TOTRST.AI_INPT_CMN_CD = Z.TOTALTEXT_AI_INPT_RST_CD LEFT OUTER JOIN CSPD112TI ITMRST ON ITMRST.AI_INPT_GRP_CD = '170' AND ITMRST.AI_INPT_CMN_CD = Z.ITM_INPT_AI_INPT_RST_CD LEFT OUTER JOIN CSPD112TI SAFRST ON SAFRST.AI_INPT_GRP_CD = '170' AND SAFRST.AI_INPT_CMN_CD = Z.SAFEWATCH_AI_INPT_RST_CD
WHERE 1=1
ORDER BY INPT_ATMC_BIZ_NM
ORDER BY INPT_ATMC_BIZ_NM DESC
ORDER BY ACTL_FX_REFNO
ORDER BY ACTL_FX_REFNO DESC
ORDER BY Z.WRR_INFO
ORDER BY Z.WRR_INFO DESC
ORDER BY INPT_PRCSNM
ORDER BY INPT_PRCSNM DESC
ORDER BY INPT_ATVTNM
ORDER BY INPT_ATVTNM DESC
ORDER BY FC_CUNM
ORDER BY FC_CUNM DESC
ORDER BY AI_INPT_BUY_AM
ORDER BY AI_INPT_BUY_AM DESC
ORDER BY AI_INPT_CUS_NM
ORDER BY AI_INPT_CUS_NM DESC
ORDER BY TOTALTEXT_AI_INPT_RST_NM
ORDER BY TOTALTEXT_AI_INPT_RST_NM DESC
ORDER BY ITM_INPT_AI_INPT_RST_NM
ORDER BY ITM_INPT_AI_INPT_RST_NM DESC
ORDER BY SAFEWATCH_AI_INPT_RST_NM
ORDER BY SAFEWATCH_AI_INPT_RST_NM DESC
ORDER BY INPT_RCP_DT
ORDER BY INPT_RCP_DT DESC
ORDER BY AI_INPT_CSNO
ORDER BY AI_INPT_CSNO DESC
ORDER BY INPT_RCP_DT DESC

/* AppStatusMapper.selectListTotCnt */
SELECT COUNT(*) totcnt FROM( SELECT Z.*
, BIZDS.AI_INPT_CMN_CD_NM AS INPT_ATMC_BIZ_NM , Y.XPBY_COL_CTR_CUCD AS FC_CUNM , PRCS.AI_INPT_CMN_CD_NM AS INPT_PRCSNM , ATVT.AI_INPT_CMN_CD_NM AS INPT_ATVTNM , TOTRST.AI_INPT_CMN_CD_ENG_NM AS TOTALTEXT_AI_INPT_RST_NM , ITMRST.AI_INPT_CMN_CD_ENG_NM AS ITM_INPT_AI_INPT_RST_NM , SAFRST.AI_INPT_CMN_CD_ENG_NM AS SAFEWATCH_AI_INPT_RST_NM , Y.XPBY_COL_AM , Y.CUS_KORL_NM , Y.CSNO FROM ( SELECT '3' AS AI_INPT_BIZ_DSCD , A.ACTL_FX_REFNO , A.AI_INPT_QLAS_PROS_CD AS PRCS_CD , A.AI_INPT_QLAS_ACVT_CD AS ATVT_CD , A.TOTALTEXT_AI_INPT_RST_CD , A.ITM_INPT_AI_INPT_RST_CD , A.SAFEWATCH_AI_INPT_RST_CD , A.INPT_MST_SRNO , A.INPT_RCP_DT , A.AI_INPT_IMG_KEY_NO , A.FX_REFNO_SRNO FROM CSPD001TM A WHERE A.QLAS_SNPE_ENO = #{userId} AND A.AI_INPT_QLAS_ACVT_CD IN ('110', '160') AND A.AI_INPT_QLAS_APPV_STCD IN ('120', '160')
AND A.ACTL_FX_REFNO LIKE '%' || UPPER(#{actlFxRefno}) || '%'
UNION ALL
SELECT A.INPT_ATMC_BIZ_DSCD AS AI_INPT_BIZ_DSCD , A.ACTL_FX_REFNO
, A.AI_INPT_PROS_CD AS PRCS_CD , A.AI_INPT_ACVT_CD AS ATVT_CD , A.TOTALTEXT_AI_INPT_RST_CD , A.ITM_INPT_AI_INPT_RST_CD , A.SAFEWATCH_AI_INPT_RST_CD , A.INPT_MST_SRNO , A.INPT_RCP_DT , A.AI_INPT_IMG_KEY_NO , A.FX_REFNO_SRNO FROM CSPD001TM A WHERE A.AI_INPT_SNPE_ENO = #{userId} AND A.AI_INPT_ACVT_CD IN ('90', '140', '160') AND A.AI_INPT_APPV_STCD IN ('120', '140', '160')
AND A.ACTL_FX_REFNO LIKE '%' || UPPER(#{actlFxRefno}) || '%'
) Z LEFT OUTER JOIN ( SELECT FX_ACNO AS ACTL_FX_REFNO , TDOC_RCP_CUCD AS XPBY_COL_CTR_CUCD , TDOC_RCP_AM AS XPBY_COL_AM , CUS_KORL_NM , CSNO , TDOC_RCP_SRNO AS FX_REFNO_SRNO FROM CSPD202TM
UNION ALL
SELECT FX_ACNO AS ACTL_FX_REFNO , XPBY_COL_CTR_CUCD AS XPBY_COL_CTR_CUCD , XPBY_COL_AM AS XPBY_COL_AM , CUS_KORL_NM , CSNO , XPO_CVRG_MK_SQ AS FX_REFNO_SRNO FROM CSPD201TM ) Y ON Y.ACTL_FX_REFNO = Z.ACTL_FX_REFNO AND Z.FX_REFNO_SRNO = Y.FX_REFNO_SRNO LEFT OUTER JOIN CSPD112TI BIZDS ON BIZDS.AI_INPT_GRP_CD = '150' AND BIZDS.AI_INPT_CMN_CD = Z.AI_INPT_BIZ_DSCD LEFT OUTER JOIN CSPD112TI PRCS ON PRCS.AI_INPT_GRP_CD = '280' AND PRCS.AI_INPT_CMN_CD = Z.PRCS_CD LEFT OUTER JOIN CSPD112TI ATVT ON ATVT.AI_INPT_GRP_CD = '290' AND ATVT.AI_INPT_CMN_CD = Z.ATVT_CD LEFT OUTER JOIN CSPD112TI TOTRST ON TOTRST.AI_INPT_GRP_CD = '170' AND TOTRST.AI_INPT_CMN_CD = Z.TOTALTEXT_AI_INPT_RST_CD LEFT OUTER JOIN CSPD112TI ITMRST ON ITMRST.AI_INPT_GRP_CD = '170' AND ITMRST.AI_INPT_CMN_CD = Z.ITM_INPT_AI_INPT_RST_CD LEFT OUTER JOIN CSPD112TI SAFRST ON SAFRST.AI_INPT_GRP_CD = '170' AND SAFRST.AI_INPT_CMN_CD = Z.SAFEWATCH_AI_INPT_RST_CD
WHERE 1=1 )
